cases.sentence: Надел Иосифа начинался у Иордана иерихонского , к востоку от ___, и тянулся оттуда через пустыню до нагорий Вефиля.
cases.explain: «иерихонских вод» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, even the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.

cases.sentence: От Таппуаха граница шла на запад к потоку Кане и доходила до ___.
cases.explain: «самого моря» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;

cases.sentence: Еще он включал все города с ___, которые были отделены ефремитам в уделе манасситов.
cases.explain: «окрестными поселениями» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

cases.sentence: Они не выселили хананеев, живущих в Гезере; до ___ хананеи живут среди ефремитов, но как подневольные.
cases.explain: «сегодняшнего дня» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this day, and have become servants to do forced labor.
